usdRate.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (two months of 2026/27)
usdRate.note: Buying rate per US dollar, mid-September 2026; rupee pegged to the Indian rupee at 1.6

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (two months of 2026/27)
inflation_cpi.note: Year-on-year CPI, mid-September 2026; food 7.54%, non-food and services 5.69%

inflation_projection.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank inflation target for 2026/27 (around 5.5%); recent CPI 1.9% to 6.3%
inflation_projection.note: The central bank's 5.5% target sits close to the 5-year CPI average, so we plan with it.

policy_rate.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, NRB Policy Rates
policy_rate.note: Policy (overnight repo) rate 4.25% since 2 December 2025, still shown as current on the NRB page in November 2026; standing deposit facility 2.75%, standing liquidity facility 5.75%. A Rising Nepal report on the 2026/27 monetary policy says 4.50%, which does not match the NRB page.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Deposit/Lending Rates (weighted average saving deposit rate)
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average rate on saving deposits, last updated 6 April 2026; the overall weighted average deposit rate of commercial banks fell from 3.45% to 3.11% by mid-September 2026, so current savings rates may be slightly lower.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Only individual banks' published rate notices give 3-month fixed deposit rates (about 2.8% to 2.9% in Bhadra to Ashwin 2083); Nepal Rastra Bank publishes only a weighted average on all outstanding fixed deposits (5.11%, April 2026), which is not term-specific.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Only individual banks' published rate notices give 1-year fixed deposit rates (about 3.0% to 3.2% in Bhadra 2083); Nepal Rastra Bank publishes only a weighted average on all outstanding fixed deposits (5.11%, April 2026), which is not term-specific.

dps_rate.note: Recurring deposit rates appear only in individual banks' rate notices; no regulator or statistics-office figure found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (two months of 2026/27)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average deposit rate of commercial banks; development banks 3.48%, finance companies 4.04%

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: The Rising Nepal (Citizen Savings Bond 2087 issue by Nepal Rastra Bank)
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Citizen Savings Bond 2087, 5 years, interest paid half-yearly, minimum Rs 10,000; Foreign Employment Savings Bond 7.5%. Issued in tranches, not on tap

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (two months of 2026/27)

tbond_5y_rate.note: Searched Nepal Rastra Bank and Public Debt Management Office auction results for recent 5-year development bond cut-off rates; no readable 2026 result found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Searched Nepal Rastra Bank and Public Debt Management Office auction results for recent 10-year development bond cut-off rates; no readable 2026 result found.

tax_bank_interest.note: 6% withholding on interest paid to natural persons on deposits, not related to business; final withholding

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Searched issue notices for Citizen Savings Bonds 2086 and 2087; they do not state the tax on the interest.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: The Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund site (dcgf.gov.np) refused connections and the NRB Financial Stability Report 2024/25 does not state the per-depositor limit; only a non-official directory page gives Rs 500,000.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No Nepal Rastra Bank cap or regulator statistic on credit card rates found; only individual banks' card terms publish a rate.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (two months of 2026/27): NEPSE index 2,612 in mid-September 2026 versus 2,672 a year earlier
equity_return_low.note: NEPSE was about 1,800 to 1,900 in 2016 and 2,612 in September 2026, roughly 3% a year in price with large swings, so the low case is near zero real return.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (two months of 2026/27): NEPSE index; after-tax weighted average deposit rate about 2.9%
equity_return_base.note: Set below the after-tax safe rate plus 4 points because the NEPSE 10-year record (about 3% a year in price plus dividends) is weak.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Nepal Rastra Bank, Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation (two months of 2026/27): NEPSE index; nominal GDP growth
equity_return_high.note: Upper case if earnings follow nominal GDP growth of around 9 to 10%.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Rupee pegged to the Indian rupee; dollar gold long-run trend
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with mild rupee depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Dollar gold long-run trend plus rupee depreciation through the INR peg
gold_return_base.note: About 4% dollar gold trend plus about 3% expected rupee depreciation against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Dollar gold long-run trend plus rupee depreciation
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and faster rupee depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Weighted average deposit rate of commercial banks 3.11% (mid-September 2026) less 6% withholding
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits after 6% tax, about 2.5% to 2.9%.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Commercial bank deposit rates (weighted average 3.11%, outstanding fixed deposits 5.11%) and Citizen Savings Bond 6.5%, after 6% tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a ladder of term deposits with some savings bonds when issued.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: mostly savings bonds and long deposits bought at current rates.

life_claim_settlement_rate.sourceName: Beema Post (Nepal Insurance Authority data, first 11 months of FY 2082/83)
life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Life insurers paid 265,204 claims (Rs 66.42 bn) with 60,954 pending (Rs 0.55 bn): 81% by number, 99% by amount

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life plans are sold in Nepal but no published premium rates or regulator premium data were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Searched for published typical private hospital stay costs in Nepal; none found from a credible source.

health_premium_table.note: Searched for published private health insurance premiums by age; none found. The public Health Insurance Board scheme charges a family premium instead.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Nepal CPI (non-food and services 5.7%) and 5.5% inflation target
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical costs usually rise faster than headline CPI, so we add 1.5 points to the target.

goal_inflation_education.note: Private school and college fees have risen faster than headline CPI, so we add 2.5 points to the target.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 (via Our World in Data)
life_table_remaining.note: 2025 estimates; projected = 2050 medium variant; ages 60 and 70 not published in this series

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 old-age dependency ratio (via Our World in Data)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio (10.1 in 2025, 12.5 in 2040, 25.5 in 2065, medium variant)

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Social Security Fund, Social Security Operation Procedure 2075 (5th amendment 2081)
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension from age 60 after at least 180 months of contributions, same for men and women; procedure amended 2081/09/10 (25 December 2024), older than 2025 but still in force.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: The Kathmandu Post (Civil Service Act 2049, section 33)
retirement_age_government.note: Federal Civil Service Bill before parliament would raise it to 60

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Weighted average deposit rate 3.11% less 6% withholding

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Weighted average deposit rate of commercial banks 3.11% (mid-September 2026) less 6% withholding = 2.92%
retirement_return_base.note: Kept at about the after-tax average deposit rate; the 91-day treasury bill (1.35%) is lower but is bought mostly by banks.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Outstanding fixed deposits (5.11% weighted average) and Citizen Savings Bond 6.5%, after 6% tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case using longer deposits and savings bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Balanced mix of deposits and NEPSE equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix while rates stay low.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Balanced mix: half safe fixed income (3.5%), half equity (6%)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Average of the base fixed-income and equity cases.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Balanced mix with higher equity returns
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social security allowance for senior citizens; universal, not means-tested

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Age 60 for Dalits and residents of the Karnali region; categorical, no means test

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Labour Act 2074, section 53 (copy published by the Social Security Fund)
gratuity_rule.note: Employers must deposit 8.33% of basic remuneration every month as gratuity, which is one month (30 days) per year of service; for enrolled employees it goes into the Social Security Fund. Act of 2017, older than 2025 but still in force.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Social Security Fund, Social Security Operation Procedure 2075 (5th amendment 2081)
public_pension_scheme.note: Contribution-based: employee 11% plus employer 20% of basic salary (31%), of which 28.33% goes to the old-age protection scheme; pension from 60 after 180 months of contributions. Procedure amended December 2024, older than 2025 but still in force.

dps.note: Recurring deposits are offered for terms of about 1 to 5 years

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Issued by Nepal Rastra Bank in tranches for Nepali citizens; Foreign Employment Savings Bond for migrant workers

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by Nepal Rastra Bank; bought mostly by banks and financial institutions

tbond_5y.note: Government development bonds, auctioned and listed on NEPSE

equity_fund.note: Closed-end and open-end mutual funds regulated by the Securities Board of Nepal

gold.note: Gold is sold mainly as jewellery and tola-weight pieces

oldAgeAllowance.name: Department of National ID and Civil Registration (social security allowance)
